title: Dealer Lead and Reorder Automation
summary: Use dealer billing history to send timely WhatsApp reorder suggestions, flag dealers going quiet, and qualify new dealer enquiries before they reach the area sales manager.

seo.title: Dealer Reorder and Lead Automation | VipraTech
seo.description: WhatsApp reorder suggestions from dealer billing history, lapsed-dealer alerts for sales officers and qualification of new dealer enquiries for ASMs.

problem.intro: Sales officers spend most of their time with the dealers who already order often, while smaller dealers drift to a competitor without anyone noticing. New dealer enquiries from the website, B2B marketplaces and trade fairs sit in spreadsheets until someone finds time to call.

pain_points.title: Small dealers go quiet
pain_points.detail: Dealers outside the sales officer's regular beat stop ordering, and the drop shows up only in the quarterly review.

pain_points.title: Leads that go cold
pain_points.detail: Enquiries from IndiaMART, the website and expos are not qualified or routed for days, and good prospects sign with another brand.

pain_points.title: Broadcast messages
pain_points.detail: Reorder reminders and scheme updates go out as the same WhatsApp broadcast to every dealer, so they are ignored or blocked.

pain_points.title: No record of why
pain_points.detail: When a dealer stops ordering, nobody records whether it was price, credit, stock or service.

solution.overview: We build an automation layer on top of your billing and DMS data. For each dealer it learns the usual purchase cycle by SKU group and, when a reorder is due, sends a WhatsApp suggestion based on recent run rate that the dealer can confirm in one tap as a draft order. Dealers who miss their usual window are flagged to the sales officer with context. New enquiries are qualified by a WhatsApp or web assistant that asks about territory, business type, current brands and expected volumes, then routed to the right ASM in the CRM with a summary. Messages use only approved templates and schemes.
capabilities: Learns each dealer's purchase cycle by SKU group from invoice history
Sends WhatsApp reorder suggestions with one-tap confirmation as a draft order
Flags dealers who miss their usual ordering window, with last order, outstanding and open complaints
Qualifies new dealer enquiries from website, marketplace and expo leads and routes them to the right ASM
Tailors scheme messages to the SKUs and slabs relevant to each dealer
Records lapse reasons captured by sales officers for monthly review

workflow.title: Sync billing and lead data
workflow.detail: Dealer invoices, outstanding and lead feeds are synced daily from ERP, DMS and lead sources.

workflow.title: Score reorder and lapse risk
workflow.detail: Each dealer's purchase cycle is compared with recent orders to find due reorders and lapsing dealers.

workflow.title: Choose the action
workflow.detail: Due reorders get a WhatsApp suggestion; lapsing or key dealers become sales officer tasks.

workflow.title: Qualify new enquiries
workflow.detail: A WhatsApp or web assistant asks qualifying questions and checks the territory against your dealer map.

workflow.title: Sales follow-up
workflow.detail: ASMs receive qualified leads and sales officers receive lapse tasks with context in the CRM.

workflow.title: Confirm and learn
workflow.detail: Confirmed draft orders go to the order desk, and outcomes feed into the next cycle.

inputs: Dealer-wise invoice history by SKU from ERP or DMS
Outstanding, credit and complaint status per dealer
Lead feeds from the website, B2B marketplaces and trade fair forms
Dealer territory map and ASM assignments
Approved scheme circulars and WhatsApp templates
outputs: WhatsApp reorder suggestions and confirmed draft orders
Lapse alerts and call tasks for sales officers
Qualified dealer leads routed to ASMs with summaries
Lapse reason log and monthly review dashboard
human_in_the_loop: The order desk checks every dealer-confirmed draft order before booking, and ASMs decide on new dealer onboarding, including credit and GST checks. Marketing approves templates, schemes and frequency rules before any message goes out.
integrations: SAP, Tally or DMS for invoices and outstanding
CRM such as Salesforce, Zoho or LeadSquared
Lead sources such as website forms and IndiaMART lead exports
Sales force automation app used by sales officers
guardrails: Messages only to dealers who have opted in, with frequency caps and quiet hours
Prices and schemes taken only from approved masters
No credit or delivery promises in automated messages
Holdout group kept to measure real impact
compliance_notes: Dealer proprietors are individuals, so their contact data falls under the DPDP Act 2023; consent and withdrawal are tracked.
WhatsApp messages follow the platform's opt-in and template rules, and SMS fallbacks use DLT-registered templates under TRAI rules.

pilot.scope: Dealers in one region with at least six months of billing history, plus new dealer enquiries for that region, with a holdout group of similar dealers.
deliverables: Purchase cycle and lapse model for pilot dealers
WhatsApp reorder and lead qualification flows
CRM tasks for sales officers and ASMs
Pilot report comparing messaged and holdout dealers
Roll-out plan and running cost estimate

what_we_measure.how: Share of suggestions confirmed by dealers as draft orders.
Order frequency and value of messaged dealers compared with the holdout group over the pilot.
Time from enquiry capture to qualified handover and to first ASM contact.
Dealer opt-outs and WhatsApp blocks per message sent.

faqs.q: Will dealers find automated messages annoying?
faqs.a: They do when messages are generic and frequent. Here each message is triggered by that dealer's own cycle, uses only SKUs they buy, and is capped. We track opt-outs and blocks every week of the pilot.

faqs.q: Do we need a DMS for this to work?
faqs.a: No. Dealer-wise invoice history from SAP or Tally is enough to start. A DMS adds secondary sales data, which improves the suggestions where you have it.

faqs.q: Does the sales officer still own the relationship?
faqs.a: Yes. Key dealers can be excluded from automated messages, and sales officers see every suggestion and confirmation in their app. The system gives them a better call list rather than replacing visits.

faqs.q: How do you prove it made a difference?
faqs.a: We keep a holdout group of similar dealers who receive no automated messages and compare their ordering with the messaged group. The pilot report shows both.
